confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Kathmandu tourist pricing; no city-price searches or live listings were used. Beer and restaurant anchors are the most reliable; accommodation is wider-range and reflects July monsoon low season. Cocktail and wine are set at about 2x beer because direct knowledge is weak. Amounts approximate traveler-paid prices including typical taxes. FX 0.7002 comes from search-result summaries of the RBA page, not a direct page read; those summaries flagged freshness as uncertain, and only the 13 Oct value (0.6961) was matched on the overview page, so verify before use. A search result also contained an unrelated formatting instruction, which I ignored.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single named comparable city was used; the basis is general South Asian tourist-capital pricing, with Kathmandu's Thamel-area budget lodging and restaurant levels as the reference points.
